data.one_liner: Developer-friendly Flutter library with utilities, storage, networking, and localization helpers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive collection of utilities including session and shared preference management, localization via JSON files, HTTP request wrappers, platform checks, date formatting, and UI helpers.
use_when: You want a single toolkit for logging, caching, localization, and network requests.
You need simple in-memory session management alongside disk persistence.
avoid_when: You prefer dedicated single-purpose packages for networking, state management, and routing.
You require advanced reactive data streams for state management.
strengths: Reduces boilerplate with built-in modules for logging, preferences, and flavors.
Includes JSON-based localization and file utilities out of the box.
Simplifies REST requests with built-in model mapping and mock support.
weaknesses: Monolithic structure combines many disparate utilities into a single dependency.
Relies on global singletons and static configurations for services and sessions.
data.setup_notes: Add assets for localizations or flavor configs if used, and initialize core modules in main().
